name: Rungs
description: Answer the clues, then order the words into a ladder, one letter apart.
hint: Click a rung and type · drag rungs (or ⌥↑↓) to order them · ↑↓ to move

howTo.goal: Answer five clues, then put the answers in order so each word changes just one letter from the next.
rules: Click a rung to see its clue, and type the answer; a right answer gets a tick.
Drag the rungs into order. Then the top and bottom rungs open, with one clue for both.
One puzzle a day; past days are in the archive.
